<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
<title>Mariana Costa Advocacia — Direito Trabalhista e de Família</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1f3a5f; --navy-d:#14273f; --deep:#0e1f33;
    --gold:#c9a24b; --gold-d:#a5822f;
    --bg:#f8f7f4; --surf:#f0eee8; --blue:#eaf0f6;
    --ink:#33404f; --strong:#1a2634;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Helvetica Neue",Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
  .serif{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif}
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;color:var(--strong);line-height:1.15;font-weight:600}
  a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
  .gold{color:var(--gold-d)}
  .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 28px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer;border:0}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--navy);color:#fff}
  .btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#20140a}
  .btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);color:var(--strong);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
  svg{display:block}

  /* NAV */
  nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(248,247,244,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.2)}
  nav .row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:76px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .brand .mk{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--navy)}
  .brand b{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--strong);font-weight:600}
  .navlinks{display:flex;gap:30px}
  .navlinks a{font-size:.9rem;color:rgba(51,64,79,.85)}
  .navlinks a:hover{color:var(--navy)}
  @media(max-width:820px){.navlinks{display:none}}

  /* HERO */
  .hero{position:relative;min-height:560px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, #2a4a73 0%, transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#24446e 0%,var(--navy) 45%,var(--deep) 100%)}
  .hero .scales{position:absolute;right:-40px;bottom:-40px;opacity:.06}
  .hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:760px;padding:90px 24px}
  .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#f3e9d4;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:26px}
  .hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4rem);margin-bottom:22px}
  .hero h1 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
  .hero p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);font-size:1.15rem;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 34px}
  .hero .cta{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}

  section{padding:80px 0}
  /* PROOF */
  .proof{background:var(--surf);border-top:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.15);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.15);padding:34px 0}
  .proof p{text-align:center;color:var(--gold-d);font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}
  .proof .logos{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:56px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .proof .logos span{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--ink);opacity:.7}

  /* FEATURES */
  .sec-head{text-align:center;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 52px}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,2.6rem);margin-bottom:12px}
  .sec-head p{color:rgba(51,64,79,.7)}
  .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px}
  @media(max-width:820px){.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ece7df;border-radius:18px;padding:34px 30px;transition:box-shadow .25s,transform .25s}
  .card:hover{box-shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(31,58,95,.3);transform:translateY(-3px)}
  .card .ic{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,var(--blue),#fff);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:22px;color:var(--gold-d)}
  .card h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:10px}
  .card p{color:rgba(51,64,79,.72)}

  /* ABOUT */
  .about{background:var(--surf)}
  .about .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
  @media(max-width:820px){.about .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}}
  .portrait{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -24px rgba(20,39,63,.5);
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#33557d,var(--navy) 60%,var(--deep));display:grid;place-items:center}
  .portrait .mono{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:5rem;color:rgba(201,162,75,.85);letter-spacing:.05em}
  .portrait::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  .about .eyebrow{display:inline-block;background:rgba(201,162,75,.14);color:var(--gold-d);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .about h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.8rem);margin-bottom:8px}
  .about .role{color:var(--navy);font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:22px}
  .about .bio p{margin-bottom:16px;font-size:1.05rem}
  .stats{display:flex;gap:44px;margin-top:28px}
  .stats .n{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold-d)}
  .stats .l{font-size:.85rem;color:rgba(51,64,79,.6)}

  /* CTA */
  .ctaband{padding:70px 0}
  .ctaband .box{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--navy),var(--deep));border-radius:26px;padding:56px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .ctaband h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3.5vw,2.4rem);max-width:560px}
  .ctaband p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);margin-top:10px}

  /* FOOTER */
  footer{background:var(--bg);border-top:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.2);padding:60px 0 28px}
  .fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:40px}
  @media(max-width:820px){.fgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  footer h4{color:var(--strong);font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin-bottom:14px}
  footer .fbrand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px}
  footer ul{list-style:none}
  footer li{font-size:.9rem;color:rgba(51,64,79,.7);margin-bottom:9px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
  footer a:hover{color:var(--navy)}
  .fbot{border-top:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.14);padding-top:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(51,64,79,.5)}
</style>

Sobre a Advogada

Dra. Mariana Costa

Advocacia Trabalhista & de Família · OAB/SP

Há mais de 12 anos, a Dra. Mariana dedica sua carreira a defender trabalhadores e famílias com uma convicção: justiça se constrói com escuta. Cada caso é tratado com a atenção que a sua história merece.

Membro do IBDFAM e da AASP, ela une técnica apurada a uma comunicação clara — traduzindo o juridiquês para que você tome decisões com segurança e tranquilidade.
